tickets.title: Run tests on every pull request in CI
tickets.description: Set up the CI pipeline so unit tests run automatically on each pull request and block the merge if they fail.

criteria.text: A failing test blocks the merge

tickets.title: Add password reset email flow
tickets.description: Users who forget their password can request a reset link by email. The link expires after 30 minutes.

criteria.text: Reset email arrives within a minute
Old password stops working after reset

tickets.deliverable: PR #42: password reset endpoints and email template

tickets.title: Image carousel on the product page
tickets.description: Product pages show all product photos in a swipeable carousel instead of a single image.

criteria.text: Swipe and arrow keys both work

tickets.title: Cart total rounds wrong when a discount applies
tickets.description: With a 15% discount on a $19.99 item the cart shows $16.98 but the charge is $16.99. Rounding happens at different steps.

criteria.text: Cart total and charged amount always match

tickets.title: Dark mode toggle in settings
tickets.description: Add a dark mode switch on the settings page that remembers the user's choice.

criteria.text: Toggle switches the whole app's theme
Choice is remembered on the next visit

tickets.title: Paginate the order history API
tickets.description: The order history endpoint returns every order at once and is slow for big accounts. Return 20 per page.

criteria.text: Response time under 300 ms for 1,000 orders

tickets.title: Checkout fails on Safari when a promo code is applied
tickets.description: On Safari 17, applying a promo code at checkout shows a spinner forever and the order never goes through.

tickets.title: Make the dashboard better
tickets.question: Which part of the dashboard, and what problem are users having with it?

tickets.title: Upgrade build images to Node 22
tickets.description: Move the build and deploy images to Node 22. Waiting on the hosting vendor to support Node 22 in our region.
